verdict: Unauditable, recorded as a finding rather than swapped for another draw. `python3 platform/ci/quality_audit.py sample --seed 2026-11-08` drew platform/skills (of 20). `ls -la platform/skills` shows only a 0-byte .gitkeep; `git ls-files platform/skills` lists only that file; `git log` shows it was added in an unrelated commit (6eb7b1f0). No file in the repository other than platform/README.md (line 41, 'Placeholder for shared agent skills') mentions the path, so no claim is unbacked. There is no logic, test suite or output to score.
